name: dev.mcpharbor.gateway/npm_registry
title: npm Registry
description: Search the npm package registry: versions, dependencies, download stats and metadata

compliance.reasoning: npm's Open Source Terms explicitly permit replicating registry data via the documented Public APIs and place no blanket ban on commercial use of ordinary package metadata (only a narrower restriction applies to redistributing Package security/vulnerability data). As long as request volume stays well under the stated 5-million-requests/month ceiling and infrastructure isn't strained, a metered lookup proxy fits within the permitted pattern.

evidence.quote: You may replicate data from the Public Registry using the Public APIs
